name: aeg-d-xcop
title: X-COP galaxy clusters: observed and baryonic accelerations as released by Eckert et al. 2022
description: Atlas conversion of the accelerations released with Eckert et al. 2022 (A&A 662, A123) under data standard 2.5.1 (D-089, D-090): g_obs from the source's non-parametric hydrostatic reconstruction and g_bar from its gas, central-galaxy and satellite masses, both as released, at the radii of the data, for the five clusters with stellar data (109 radii). The seven other X-COP clusters are listed and recorded, not plotted (no stellar mass in the source). Values differ from v1 by ruling (D-090). Built under the frozen tests REPRODUCTION.md (part A) and REPRODUCTION_PART_B.md and the frozen second reading in reading/. Published 2026-11-05 under D-106; the authors are invited to review it.
x_licence_status: No licence stated by the source; asked (#19). The two archives shared by D. Eckert are fetched at build time, verified by hash and never redistributed (D-004). Atlas tables intended CC BY 4.0 under D-004, citing the source. Published 2026-11-05 under D-106; the authors are invited to review and their wishes are followed.

sources.title: Eckert, Ettori, Pointecouteau, van der Burg & Loubser 2022, A&A 662, A123 (arXiv 2205.01110v1)
Eckert et al. 2022 data archives data_E22.tar.gz and mbar.tar.gz, shared by D. Eckert on 2026-11-03 (not redistributed)

x_citation: Eckert, D., Ettori, S., Pointecouteau, E., van der Burg, R. F. J. & Loubser, S. I. 2022, A&A 662, A123 (arXiv 2205.01110): g_obs and g_bar. The programme behind the inputs: Ettori et al. 2019 (arXiv 1805.00035; A&A 621, A39), hydrostatic masses; Eckert et al. 2019 (arXiv 1805.00034), gas; Loubser et al. 2020 (arXiv 2006.05706), central galaxies; Ghizzardi et al. 2021 (arXiv 2007.01084), satellite stellar masses. Uncertainty terms also cite Eckert et al. 2022b, A&A 666, A41 (arXiv 2205.01123) and Ettori & Eckert 2022 (arXiv 2112.07554).

x_selection.value: the five X-COP clusters with a released gbar_gobs file (A644, A1795, A2029, A2142, A2319)
x_selection.citation: Eckert et al. 2022 l. 103, 114, 402; part A §1 and A8; D-090 rule 4

x_selection.value: every released row: the radii of the data (no exclusion wording found; D-096 rule 2 as limited by D-098 rule 1 and D-105 O4)

x_baryon_inventory.citation: Eckert et al. 2022 l. 142–156 (X-ray and SZ gas density); released inside GBAR as a total
Eckert et al. 2022 l. 103–111 (dynamical mass-to-light ratio, Loubser et al. 2020); released inside GBAR as a total
Eckert et al. 2022 l. 114–116 (van der Burg et al. 2015 method; Ghizzardi et al. 2021); released inside GBAR as a total
Eckert et al. 2022 l. 410: "the contribution of ICL to the total baryon budget is expected to be small ($<5\%$)"; its effect is the uncertainty term icl_omitted
As v1: cold gas is not included by the source

x_baryon_inventory_note: The measured components are released as one total (GBAR), so v2's component columns are empty and their statuses are not_separable (REPRODUCTION_PART_B.md item 2).
x_precedence: D-089 (v2 from Eckert et al. 2022) and D-090 rule 1: the source's own released g_obs and g_bar are used, the one exception to D-083 item 3, so v2 is not compared with v1.
x_search_log: docs/sources/uncertainty-readings.md §3, §3b, §3c; docs/sources/readings/xcop-e22-2026-11-03/ (step A readers A and B)

x_second_reading.off_repo: source/reading/values.csv (the reader's parse of the archives; not committed; its hash is in the freeze record)

x_previous_version: aeg-d-xcop/v1 (standard 1.2.1); values differ by ruling (D-090), not compared
x_cosmology: As the source: H0 = 67.8 km/s/Mpc, Omega_m = 0.308 (Eckert et al. 2022 l. 56)
